headline: Brazil's Vale Falls 3.23% in New York Amid Broader Market Turmoil
summary: Brazil's Vale fell 3.23% to US$12.00 in New York on Monday, declining far less than Brazil's 13.88% market crash, while Rio Tinto rose 0.36% to US$83.72.
why: Vale is one of the world's largest iron ore producers, serving as a primary bellwether for emerging market mining equities and global steel supply chains.

impacts.name: Vale S.A.
impacts.why: Fell 3.23% in New York amid severe domestic market volatility in Brazil.

why_moved: Widespread domestic market turmoil in Brazil exerted negative pressure on locally domiciled multinationals, though international ADR listings cushioned part of the drop.
